Clever Devices is hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer focused on React Native to build custom-branded telemedicine apps and healthcare CRMs for Clever Benefits. The role owns mobile features end-to-end, including the full release cycle across the App Store and Google Play, and maintains shared architecture spanning multiple white-label client apps. The core stack is React Native and TypeScript with native iOS and Android work, backed by Node.js, tRPC, MongoDB or PostgreSQL, and AWS.
